summary_bullets: Collapse mechanical `/implement` Preflight admission, issue fetch, plan extraction, and emergency fallback handling into one helper
Keep the main-agent audit boundary on item 4 with refuse-only `audit.txt` state

commit_message:
Collapse implement preflight mechanical gates

Add scripts/implement-preflight.sh to own admission, issue fetch, plan-block extraction, and emergency fallback composition for /implement Preflight items 1-3. Update the implement skill and audit reference so prompt-side judgment begins after the helper succeeds, with audit.txt written only on refuse.

Add the offline implement-preflight harness, wire it into Makefile and linting docs, and retarget existing Preflight structure tests to the single helper surface.
todos_left: bash scripts/relevant-checks.sh was attempted, but the tool session yielded before final completion; targeted harnesses, shellcheck on changed scripts, check-contains-pins, agent-lint, and git diff --check passed.
